messages:
Lena (support): Hey team, customer ACME (ticket #45218) seeing repeated partial SSE events when clients reconnect through our gRPC-web gateway. They get a few tokens then the stream ends with no error, client reconnect resumes with overlapping prefix -> duplicated partial messages and a sawtooth output pattern. They say this started after we rolled the gateway proxy last week.
Devon (eng-runtime): Can you paste the minimal repro and any gateway logs?
Lena (support): Repro steps from customer: 1) client (browser) open conn to /v1/stream via gRPC-web reverse proxy (nginx+grpcweb) 2) server is upstream on HTTP/2 SSE-> our runtime 3) interrupt network for ~1s (simulate unstable mobile) 4) client reconnects -> first chunk truncated, next reconnect starts from earlier prefix. curl-based repro: 
```
curl -N -H "Accept: text/event-stream" \ 
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \ 
  https://gateway.example.com/v1/stream
```
Lena (support): Customer attached this gateway capture; key snippet: 
```
...
[upstream->gateway] H2 chunk: "Hello, this is a par"
[drop /conn/reset]
[gateway->client] H1 chunk: "Hello, this is a "
[client reconnect]
[gateway->client] H1 chunk: "par tial output\n"
...
```
Lena (support): They see duplicates like: "Hello, this is a Hello, this is a partial output" in the final transcript. Billing anomaly: tokens counted twice on reconnects, customer flagged spike.
Devon (eng-runtime): Sounds like boundary-handling + proxy re-fragmentation. If gateway converts H2 frames into multiple H1 chunks on reconnect we'd see prefix carryover. Any trace id or route config?
Lena (support): Route is standard grpcweb -> ingress-nginx -> our gateway. No special keepalive config. Trace id: t-ACME-45218-9. Logs show 503s on the proxy around the reconnect windows but upstream never returns an error.
Andre (eng-infra): Can we get the gateway's raw bytes around connection close? Also, what's the runtime behavior on resume? Do we replay KV cache or resume from a token index?
Devon (eng-runtime): Our runtime keeps an append-only delta until the connection fully ACKs delivery. On reconnect we don't retroactively resend old tokens; we expose the model stream to the gateway. If gateway resends partial buffer client-side we could double-count because the client-side read produces duplicate tokens which are POSTed to our billing pipeline when the client confirms. Need exact sequence of deliver vs ack.
Ingrid (eng-ml): On the model side, partial outputs shouldn't be re-generated unless request retried. This looks like proxy-level reordering/fragmentation. Could be grpc-web wrapper treating remaining buffer as a new event on reconnect.
Devon (eng-runtime): Quick repro I ran locally with nginx grpc_web config toggled: when I set http2_buffer_size low and enabled upstream_chunked_transfer, reconnect caused chunk boundary shift and client saw overlap. Repro snippet: 
```
# nginx conf toggles
proxy_buffering off;
proxy_set_header Connection "";
proxy_http_version 1.1;
```
Devon (eng-runtime): Turning proxy_buffering on and matching http2_buffer_size to 64k removed overlap in my test.
Lena (support): Customer is on managed gateway; they asked for a patch/fix or mitigation ASAP. Also they want billing credit for duplicate tokens.
Andre (eng-infra): Short term mitigation: add a reconnect dedupe layer in the gateway that checks last-seen byte-offset per trace id and drops obvious overlaps. Long term: ensure grpc-web gateway preserves original H2 boundaries and doesn't re-chunk on reconnect.
Devon (eng-runtime): I can prototype a small guard that emits a boundary-hash with each event (lightweight) so that downstream can dedupe repeated prefixes on reconnect. Would need product sign-off for behaviour change.
Lena (support): Customer asked for an ETA and workaround. Can we recommend config change to their nginx/grpcweb?
Andre (eng-infra): Recommend: enable proxy_buffering on the gateway, increase http2_buffer_size, and disable any middleware that converts H2 > H1 chunking at reconnect. I'll draft exact commands.
Lena (support): Please post the commands and I'll pass to customer. Also attach a note to billing for spike review (ticket #45218-billing).
support-bot: Deploy check: last gateway deploy was 2024-05-02 03:12 UTC (deploy id d-20240502-17). No config rollbacks since then.
Devon (eng-runtime): Action items: 1) Andre - share nginx/grpcweb config snippet + commands (ETA 2h) 2) Me - prototype lightweight boundary-hash dedupe (ETA EOD) 3) Ingrid - confirm model/runtime won't double-charge if duplicate tokens filtered upstream (ETA 4h) 4) Lena - update customer with config mitigations and escalate billing.
Lena (support): Thanks — I'll update ACME after Andre posts the commands.
Andre (eng-infra): Posting proposed workaround:
```
# nginx snippet to recommend
proxy_buffering on;
proxy_buffers 8 16k;
http2_max_field_size 16k;
http2_max_header_size 64k;
# avoid re-chunking on reconnect by preserving stream frames
proxy_set_header Connection "keep-alive";
```
Andre (eng-infra): Also flagged an issue with our docs to call out grpc-web re-chunking pitfalls.
Lena (support): Great. If this reproduces for them we'll open a formal bug and link to runtime ticket. :thumbsup:
